blocks.title: Wireless Security Settings exam shortcuts
items: Use WPA3 when supported for stronger wireless protection.
Example: New enterprise access points use WPA3-Enterprise.
RADIUS commonly provides AAA for network access.
Example: Wi-Fi users authenticate through a central RADIUS server.
Question asks how traffic is protected → CRYPTOGRAPHIC PROTOCOL
Example: TLS protects data in transit.
Question asks how user/device identity is verified → AUTHENTICATION PROTOCOL
Example: EAP-TLS uses certificates for authentication.
blocks.example: Focus on what the resource needs: baseline consistency, hardening, secure access, isolation, authentication, or monitoring.

questions.q: A company is deploying a new wireless network and wants the strongest modern Wi-Fi security standard supported by its devices. Which should it choose?
questions.explanation: WPA3 is the modern Wi-Fi security standard.

questions.q: Enterprise Wi-Fi authentication should be handled centrally with authentication, authorization, and accounting. Which service is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: RADIUS provides centralized AAA and is commonly used with 802.1X.

questions.q: A question asks which protocol protects the confidentiality and integrity of network traffic. Which category is being tested?
questions.explanation: Cryptographic protocols protect communications through encryption and integrity.

questions.q: A question asks how a wireless user or device proves identity before access. Which category is being tested?
